customs_home_goods.tariff: 0% general duty on our categories, temporary to 2028-05-31 (fulfillment-research 1.2, shaarolami 2026-10-09)

consolidated_parcel_over_threshold.rule: above $75 VAT 18% is charged on the full CIF value (goods + freight + insurance), not on the excess
consolidated_parcel_over_threshold.split_rule: shipments from the same supplier to the same importer within 72 hours count as one shipment (צו ייבוא אישי, תשע"ט-2019, s.3); a Chamber of Commerce article says any suppliers within 72 hours (contradiction, לא אומת)
consolidated_parcel_over_threshold.israel_post: a parcel is released whole or not at all; > $150 recipient ID required; > $1,000 power of attorney
consolidated_parcel_over_threshold.quantity: up to 30 units of the same type per shipment up to $1,000; 5 units above $1,000

courier_example_ship_co_il.75_500_usd: release 174.33 + handling 18.72 + computer fee 18 (>= $100) ILS, VAT on CIF

recipient_fees.online_payment: Israel Post: taxes up to 300 ILS can be paid online

standards_personal_import.law: חוק התקנים amendment 2018 (effective 2018-07-01) + צו ייבוא אישי, תשע"ט-2019: personal/family use by a non-business importer, reasonable quantity; second schedule = must meet standard and show approval; third schedule = exempt; not for food, motor vehicles, medical devices
standards_personal_import.lighting: in the visible part of the order, the second schedule lists only specific lamp types (recessed lamps 'מנורות גומחה' ת"ר 20 part 2.2; medical lamps part 2.25); general luminaires 9405 not seen. Earlier research (shaarolami) says the ת"ר 20/900/61558 requirement applies to personal import of 9405: contradiction, לא אומת
standards_personal_import.kids: toys (ת"י 562), children's products and children's tableware (ת"י 14372) not found in the part read; לא אומת
standards_personal_import.ceramic_tableware: ת"י 1003 not found in the part read; לא אומת
